scores.comment: The brief captures the full hidden need in three well-chosen questions: the bottom-10%-by-units AND margin-below-20% rule, the last 12 months, grouping by category, the units/revenue/margin columns, and the buying-plan decision. It also states its assumptions clearly (cancellations, ranking across all products rather than within each category, ties, new launches). Small gaps keep it from full marks: the time range says roughly Oct 2025–Sep 2026 and also says to fall back to the prior 12 full months if September is incomplete. The per-unit cost basis (current vs. historical cost) is not pinned down, and the new-launch treatment is left for the stakeholder to approve.
